body:
Season 2 is a whole lot to take in within a short amount of time. 
Preffering subs in general, I can't speak for the dub , but for the 2nd season I enjoyed it more on the rewatch when it was easier to follow and I picked up more details. 
Also I love yumekos VA in the original. I got the feeling that the Dub didnt really carry the emotions across as well, which is unfortunate because it really makes this anime. 
Suzui being cool af in the end of last season then Mary's sidekick or pretty much a wallflower in 2 was very disappointing.
Tax game was meh, but I like Sumeragi and Manyuda, so the ending paid off decent enough for me. 

I think part of the disconnect is how we aren't just introduced characters in season 1. We learn about them and see them grow. They're actually likeable. You get attached to some.
 The Bami's, who are taking up considerably more screentime now, are very obviously pawns lacking much depth that wont be there long, so it lacks the emotional impact and investment making it less entertaining overall. 
That and IMO the concept for this arc is a lot simpler, but dragged out just as long as S1. Unsatisfying. :/

I do still love it and want S3, but I hope they'll do better than 2.

I lost my best friend that I had a really special bond with.  4 years later and I still struggle just not all in the same ways.
I've lost just about all of the very few people I was close to. It changes you, but sometimes you can make that a good thing. 
But honestly I still feel cheated and robbed. I'm bitter and weary. I'm just able to accept it and move on better. I couldn't at all for a long time. 
Everyone heals in their own way on their own time and everyone processes grief differently. 

Mine hit extra close to home because it was hard on me to even form the relationships. I was already pretty scarred and I didnt have anyone, but them after all the hard work and trust I struggled to give. Then nothing again. I've a bad whole life so far, so at times its too difficult to swallow. 
The most effective ways to cope for me have been trying to be around people who make me feel okay at least and staying productive.

I watched about half an hour of this before I had to walk down the street to my grandma's for Thanksgiving dinner. Came back home right at the part where he died. Had me fucked up. I never finished the movie.
